# Impeccable skill archive

Archived 11 November 2026 from the locally installed **Impeccable 4.3.1** plugin at `C:/Users/LENOVO/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-curated-remote/impeccable/4.3.1/`.

Official upstream: [pbakaus/impeccable](https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable). Plugin metadata declares Apache-2.0. The upstream license is retained here as `LICENSE` after retrieval. This is the installed version the session used, not a claim to have downloaded the latest upstream release.

## Organization

- `skills/impeccable/SKILL.md` — complete umbrella skill.
- `skills/impeccable/reference/` — every bundled command playbook and design reference, including craft, shape, init, document, extract, critique, audit, polish, bolder, quieter, distill, harden, onboard, animate, colorize, typeset, layout, delight, overdrive, clarify, adapt, optimize, live, hooks, doctor, and native-platform guidance.
- `skills/impeccable/scripts/` — bundled launcher and its source helper files, preserved without running or modifying them.
- `plugin-metadata/` — original manifest and associated branding metadata.
- `archive-manifest.json` — file inventory, sizes, and SHA-256 digests for the archived source files.

The plugin version has **one umbrella skill**, with command-specific playbooks under its reference directory. This archive includes all of them, rather than inventing separate SKILL.md files for commands. Future agents should read only the references applicable to their task and respect the selected design specification.

No hook, skill, binary, or external runtime was installed by copying this archive. Its context engine was unavailable in the current sandbox; the source guidance was read directly. Update the archive only on an explicit maintenance request, and retain source/version/license provenance.
